mechanism: Propylthiouracil may cause agranulocytosis and bone marrow suppression, which could theoretically increase cardiovascular complications when combined with tadalafil's vasodilatory effects in susceptible patients; additionally, both drugs undergo hepatic metabolism and propylthiouracil can cause hepatotoxicity affecting tadalafil clearance.
action: Monitor for signs of bone marrow suppression (infections, bleeding, bruising) and cardiovascular symptoms; obtain baseline and periodic CBC counts; counsel patient on adequate hydration and safe use; consider alternative antithyroid agents if cardiac risk factors are present.
